title: Add moderator-behavior-anomaly detector (T1 mitigation)
description:
Threat-model T1 mitigation surface (design.md §9). The threat-model test suite (#39) ships an #[ignore]'d T1 anomaly assertion because no detector exists yet for moderator behavioral anomalies (e.g. "moderator suddenly labels 1000 accounts at 3am").

**Scope.** Add an ObservationKind::ModeratorBehaviorAnomaly variant (or a typed Alert struct in a new detector module) that fires when a moderator's labeled-action count exceeds a configurable threshold within a rolling window. The pattern engine driver wires it into the audit-log alert stream.

**Tests.** The corresponding #[ignore] in tests/threat_t1_compromised_moderator.rs is un-ignored once this lands.
